<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_InventoryReplenishment" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/inventory-replenishment">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PurchaseOrder" name="Purchase order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_StockDelivery" name="Stock delivery"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_InventoryReplenishment">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_InventoryProcess" name="Inventory replenishment process" processRef="Process_InventoryReplenishment"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Suppliers" name="Suppliers"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PurchaseOrder" name="Purchase order" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Participant_Suppliers" messageRef="Message_PurchaseOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_StockDelivery" name="Stock delivery" sourceRef="Participant_Suppliers" targetRef="Task_ReceiveStock" messageRef="Message_StockDelivery"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_InventoryReplenishment" name="Inventory replenishment" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_InventoryReplenishment">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_WarehouseStore" name="Warehouse/store">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_MonitoringBegins</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_MonitorInventory</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ThresholdReached</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_SignalMethod</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ManualCheck</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_SignalMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveStock</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InspectQuality</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PlaceStock</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_RestockComplete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_ProcurementTeam" name="Procurement team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PlaceOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_InventorySystem" name="Inventory system">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AutomatedAlert</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateExpectedDelivery</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RecordStock</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateInventoryLevels</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_MonitoringBegins" name="Inventory monitoring begins"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MonitorInventory" name="Monitor inventory levels"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ThresholdReached" name="Reorder threshold reached?"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SignalMethod" name="Signal reorder need"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_AutomatedAlert" name="Generate automated alert"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ManualCheck" name="Perform manual check"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SignalMerge" name="Merge reorder signals"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PlaceOrder" name="Place order with suppliers" messageRef="Message_PurchaseOrder"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_UpdateExpectedDelivery" name="Update expected delivery dates"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveStock" name="Receive stock" messageRef="Message_StockDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InspectQuality" name="Inspect stock quality"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_RecordStock" name="Record stock in the system"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceStock" name="Place stock on shelves or in storage"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_UpdateInventoryLevels" name="Update inventory levels"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RestockComplete" name="Restock complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Monitor" sourceRef="StartEvent_MonitoringBegins" targetRef="Task_MonitorInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Monitor_Threshold" sourceRef="Task_MonitorInventory" targetRef="Gateway_ThresholdReached"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Threshold_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ThresholdReached" targetRef="Task_MonitorInventory">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>stockLevel > reorderThreshold</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Threshold_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ThresholdReached" targetRef="Gateway_SignalMethod">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>stockLevel <= reorderThreshold</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Signal_Automated" sourceRef="Gateway_SignalMethod" targetRef="Task_AutomatedAlert"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Signal_Manual" sourceRef="Gateway_SignalMethod" targetRef="Task_ManualCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Automated_Merge" sourceRef="Task_AutomatedAlert" targetRef="Gateway_SignalMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Manual_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ManualCheck" targetRef="Gateway_SignalMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_PlaceOrder" sourceRef="Gateway_SignalMerge" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PlaceOrder_UpdateExpected" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Task_UpdateExpectedDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateExpected_Receive" sourceRef="Task_UpdateExpectedDelivery" targetRef="Task_ReceiveStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Receive_Inspect" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveStock" targetRef="Task_InspectQuality"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inspect_Record" sourceRef="Task_InspectQuality" targetRef="Task_RecordStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Record_Place" sourceRef="Task_RecordStock" targetRef="Task_PlaceStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Place_UpdateLevels" sourceRef="Task_PlaceStock" targetRef="Task_UpdateInventoryLevels"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateLevels_End" sourceRef="Task_UpdateInventoryLevels" targetRef="EndEvent_RestockComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
